description: Central Province Provincial Council - Notify the Entertainment tax, Matale P/S, Thalawakele U/C, Ukuwela P/S and Kothmale P/S
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the implementation of entertainment tax regulations across multiple local authorities in the Central Province. It references specific ordinances (Entertainment Tax Ordinance, Tax Ordinance No. 12 of 1946, 1984 Tax Amendment Act) and establishes tax rates for entertainment programs. This falls under legal/regulatory matters as it involves the application and enforcement of existing tax laws and regulations rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
